projects.name: Akash Network
projects.product: Containerized CPU/GPU infrastructure from independent providers.
projects.human: Console deployment and bid selection.
projects.agent: CLI, SDK and documented agent tooling; external credentials and funding required.
projects.payment: Current documentation describes ACT-funded leases and managed account credits.
projects.limitation: Provider attributes and benchmarks do not prove arbitrary task correctness; recheck current funding terms.

projects.name: io.net
projects.product: GPU cloud infrastructure and separately managed inference services.
projects.human: Cloud account and self-service VM/container onboarding; some services require sales provisioning.
projects.agent: Account/API workflows; IO Intelligence has a separate inference API.
projects.payment: Buyer IO Credits and documented IO Coin supplier earnings are different mechanisms.
projects.limitation: Funding and refund descriptions conflict across documentation; confirm the selected product's current terms.

projects.name: Golem Network
projects.product: Negotiated resource execution with documented GPU inference workloads.
projects.human: Configure a requestor environment and funded wallet.
projects.agent: Yagna and requestor SDK scripts negotiate and execute workloads.
projects.payment: GLM usage invoices and debit notes, plus blockchain transaction fees.
projects.limitation: This is not guaranteed prepaid escrow; GPU and general provider requirements differ.

projects.name: Vast.ai
projects.product: GPU rental marketplace with instance and serverless worker options.
projects.human: Web marketplace search and account-funded rental.
projects.agent: CLI/API offer search and instance lifecycle under external account permissions.
projects.payment: Prepaid account credits; compute, storage and bandwidth billed separately; centralized host payout processors.
projects.limitation: Interruptions, storage charges and payout delays matter; a verified host badge is not proof of correct task output.

projects.name: Render Network
projects.product: Specialized rendering jobs and frames, not generic GPU-shell rental.
projects.human: Prepare scenes, submit rendering jobs and inspect frames.
projects.agent: Local Manager API requires access approval and a token.
projects.payment: Render Credits and network burn/mint economics; consult current task and transfer pricing.
projects.limitation: API/provider onboarding is gated. An AI-workload waitlist is not proof of generally available AI compute.

projects.name: Virtuals ACP
projects.product: Agent task offerings with budgets, escrow and deliverable approval.
projects.human: Butler provides a wallet-funded task interface.
projects.agent: Client and provider agents use priced offerings and job lifecycle APIs.
projects.payment: Current concepts describe USDC escrow released on approval or returned on rejection.
projects.limitation: Evaluation is not necessarily independent; service tasks differ from giving an agent control of principal funds.

projects.name: Olas Mech Marketplace
projects.product: Mech-delivered tools, LLM access and other agent tasks.
projects.human: Inspect registered Mechs and configure a requester.
projects.agent: Client/server interfaces support on-chain and off-chain request paths.
projects.payment: Chain-specific token, prepaid and subscription options; check the selected Mech and client version.
projects.limitation: Operator identities and benchmarks include self-reported claims; undelivered off-chain requests are not all visible in chain counts.

projects.name: SingularityNET
projects.product: Registry and marketplace for callable AI services.
projects.human: Browse and invoke services through the marketplace.
projects.agent: SDK/CLI clients interact with services and provider daemons.
projects.payment: Documented token-funded Multi-Party Escrow channels authorize service calls.
projects.limitation: Registry publication is distinct from marketplace listing; payment-channel integrity is not semantic output correctness.

projects.name: Fetch.ai / ASI
projects.product: Agentverse discovery and agent interaction, including ASI:One routing.
projects.human: Explore registered agents and compatible chat interfaces.
projects.agent: uAgents discovery and message protocols connect registered agents.
projects.payment: Payment messages identify external rails; they do not themselves transfer or verify funds.
projects.limitation: Overview documentation still marks monetization tooling forthcoming; example transaction IDs are not observed settlements.

projects.name: Bittensor
projects.product: Independent subnet incentive markets producing services such as inference.
projects.human: Select a specific subnet service or participate as an operator.
projects.agent: Consumer interfaces are subnet-specific; miners and validators use network tooling.
projects.payment: TAO/alpha emissions and staking are not a universal customer-task checkout.
projects.limitation: Validator rewards do not establish a universal service SLA or proof of a customer's completed task.

projects.name: x402
projects.product: Open HTTP payment protocol for paid resources and APIs.
projects.human: Developers integrate a paying client or protected service.
projects.agent: HTTP 402 requirements, signed payment payloads, verification and settlement.
projects.payment: On-chain settlement, directly or through a facilitator; hosted terms and fees vary.
projects.limitation: Payment verification does not verify compute quality; facilitator and client responsibilities remain external.

projects.name: Google AP2
projects.product: Authorization and evidence protocol for agent commerce.
projects.human: A trusted approval surface obtains user consent.
projects.agent: Signed checkout/payment mandates constrain autonomous purchases.
projects.payment: External credentials and processors move money; AP2 is not itself a payment processor.
projects.limitation: Current v0.2 excludes agent-to-agent mandate delegation and actual dispute-resolution procedures.

projects.name: Nevermined
projects.product: API monetization, payment plans and external paid-service discovery.
projects.human: Embedded checkout and merchant-plan purchase paths.
projects.agent: Catalog, router, REST and MCP interfaces for supported services.
projects.payment: Cards, stablecoins or credits depend on the product and merchant route.
projects.limitation: Delegated authorization is not funding; fees, reserved budgets and settlement require external reconciliation.

projects.name: Skyfire
projects.product: Managed identity and payment infrastructure for buyer/seller agents.
projects.human: Account owners configure agents, services and funding.
projects.agent: Identity and payment tokens are validated and charged by seller integrations.
projects.payment: Skyfire-managed wallets and documented charge/settlement windows.
projects.limitation: Identity tokens are not payment receipts; settlement depends on managed infrastructure and lifecycle rules.

projects.name: Payman AI
projects.product: Governed banking and payment agents for financial institutions.
projects.human: Institution-connected conversational payments and approvals.
projects.agent: Genie MCP bridge requires sign-in, provider connection and approved access.
projects.payment: Current product describes institution-held funds and existing banking rails.
projects.limitation: Not a universal permissionless payout API; old public documentation availability could not be confirmed.

projects.name: Request Network
projects.product: Payment requests, invoicing links and reconciliation.
projects.human: Dashboard-generated links and external wallet payment.
projects.agent: HTTP APIs construct requests/payment data; signing and submission remain external.
projects.payment: On-chain payment references and indexed reconciliation.
projects.limitation: A paid request is not delivery escrow or proof that compute was supplied.

projects.name: Superfluid
projects.product: Continuous token balance accrual through streaming agreements.
projects.human: Wallet-authorized stream creation, updates and closure.
projects.agent: Forwarder contracts and externally authorized software manage streams.
projects.payment: Time-accruing balance accounting with solvency buffers and liquidation mechanics.
projects.limitation: A stream is not task verification; timely closure and funding remain responsibilities outside this directory.

projects.name: Sablier
projects.product: Prefunded Lockup schedules and open-ended Flow debt accrual.
projects.human: Create or withdraw through the supported interface.
projects.agent: Contracts and indexers expose scheduled and covered balances.
projects.payment: Contract-held tokens; withdrawability depends on the product, schedule and funding.
projects.limitation: Time-based release is not task acceptance; new-chain deployment requests are in maintenance mode.

projects.name: CoW Protocol
projects.product: Intent-based token exchange through competitive solvers.
projects.human: Sign a token order using an external interface.
projects.agent: Orderbook and signing interfaces submit authorized exchange intents.
projects.payment: On-chain settlement enforces order conditions and limit prices.
projects.limitation: No guaranteed fill or off-chain work delivery; signer, allowance and contract risks remain.

projects.name: Uniswap
projects.product: Token liquidity, swaps and routed asset conversion.
projects.human: External swap interface with user approval and signing.
projects.agent: API, SDK or contracts construct trades; callers control signing and submission.
projects.payment: On-chain asset exchange with route-specific slippage and execution conditions.
projects.limitation: A swap receipt is not a compute receipt; approvals, gas, price impact and hooks introduce risk.
